thread:
marta: flagging a design question: when we save per-route/per-model views, should saved queries inherit route sampling and quota hints, or be independent so teams can run heavier sampling for investigations? trying to balance telemetry consistency with flexibility.
alex: my vote is inherit by default. Most teams expect views to reflect route-level telemetry and billing. Independent defaults will confuse cost previews.
rico: agree on default inherit. But we need a clear escape hatch for "investigation" saved queries so SREs/product can ramp sampling temporarily.
tara: UX idea: saved query create flow shows a compact row: 'Sampling: inherit (10%)' with a small chevron to open override. Overrides would list allowed buckets: 1%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 100%. limiting buckets keeps metrics cardinality sane.
marta: limiting buckets makes sense. Backend needs to reject arbitrary floats. Also need `effective_sample_rate` returned in saved query GET so console doesn't have to compute join logic client-side.
alex: for API shape, propose: POST /api/saved_queries accepts sample_policy: "inherit|override" and sample_rate: "1|5|10|25|100" (percent integer as string). If inherit, sample_rate must be null. Response adds effective_sample_rate.
rico: telemetry implications: metric keys currently include route_id + model_id. If we add sample_rate as dimension, we multiply cardinality. With bucket set it's ok. Also ensure time-series rollups aggregate across sample_rate when building route-wide baselines.
marta: alerts question: should alerts attached to saved queries compare against route baselines (so thresholds less noisy) or their own historical baselines? I think default to query-specific baselines if override is used, otherwise route baseline.
tara: console language: show badge "Sampling: inherited (route 10%)" or "Sampling: overridden (25%)" and in alert creation wizard show which baseline will be used. Add a tooltip: "Query baselines are separate when you override sampling to avoid noisy alerts."
alex: rollout wise, behind a feature flag `savedquery_sampling_override`. Start in canary orgs, then opt-in tenants, then GA. Need migration plan: existing saved queries that reference routes should have sample_policy set to inherit and effective_sample_rate set at sync time.
rico: infra tasks: 1) enforce allowed buckets at API layer, 2) change metric ingestion to add sample_bucket to metric key, 3) ensure aggregate route metrics ignore sample_bucket for overall route charts.
marta: small API draft in thread below. Please nitpick:
```
POST /api/saved_queries
{
  "name": "extractor-check",
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "r-888",
  "model_id": "m-quant-a",
  "query": "...",
  "sample_policy": "override",   // inherit | override
  "sample_rate": "25",          // percent integer as string, null when inherit
  "visibility": "team",
  "metadata": "created_by=marta"
}
```
tara: tiny suggestion: make metadata a list of strings `["created_by:marta"]` to keep fields flat for the saved doc schema. Also include `effective_sample_rate` in GET: e.g., "effective_sample_rate": "10".
alex: tests: new integration test to ensure cost preview delta when overriding sampling shows sensible increase and that alerts baseline choice is annotated.
rico: i'll prototype ingestion changes on the staging cluster this week. We also need a migration run to add `sample_policy=inherit` to all preexisting saved queries that currently have no sample annotations.
marta: action items: tara -> UX mocks + wording by Thu; alex -> API PR with enum validation; rico -> metrics ingestion plan + prototype; marta -> rollout gating doc and migration steps.
deploy-bot: feature flag `savedquery_sampling_override` created for rollout.
